brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: 7 pieces: piece:0,0,0;full center plus 6 surrounding at 1,0 / 1,-1 / 0,-1 / -1,0 / -1,1 / 0,1 level 0
7 top covers: cover:-1,0,0;full;top, cover:-1,1,0;full;top, cover:0,-1,0;full;top, cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,1,0;full;top, cover:1,-1,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps placed on all open perimeter edges (3 per outer cell) e.g., caps at -1,0 90/150/210 etc.; find_sockets for caps now returns 0 remaining

finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb at level 0, added full top covers to all 7 cells and capped all 18 exterior edges. Mesh clash clear, only loose-body warning (joint bolts optional, not required by brief).
